summary: Batch #43 — Backend (helper id-card BACK + vault 'Mark as renewed') + Frontend (member/helper picker, cohesive brand badge, vault renew modal, chat search). BACKEND pytest /app/backend/tests/test_batch43_helper_idcard_and_vault_renew.py -> 9 passed / 1 FAILED (10 total). FAILURES: (A) TestHelperIdCardBack.test_patch_clear_id_card_back_url_with_null — sending explicit JSON null to PATCH /api/helpers/{id} does NOT clear id_card_back_url. RCA: server.py:6637-6638 uses `if body.id_card_back_url is not None:` — Pydantic v2 collapses both 'field absent' and 'field set to null' to Python None, so the null case is skipped. Empty string ("") DOES clear (works via `body.id_card_back_url or None`). This matters because /app/frontend/src/components/HelperProfileFields.tsx:62 sends `{ id_card_back_url: null }` when the parent taps 'Remove' — that Remove tap will silently fail to clear the back id-card on the server. Same latent issue for id_card_url (line 6635-6636), photo_url (6631-6632), phone/address (they also use `is not None`, but the frontend passes '' for those so they clear via .strip() branch — the id_card fields are the only ones that go via null in the frontend). PASSING backend tests: POST /api/helpers persists id_card_back_url + GET returns front+back; PATCH updates id_card_back_url + GET verifies; empty-string clears back url; helper endpoints reject a child (LIST 403, POST 403, PATCH 403, GET 403); POST /api/vault/items/{id}/renew updates expiry_date (verified via GET); bad date -> 400; missing token -> 401; child (non-parent, non-owner, non-creator) -> 403; the vault_expiry notification for a renewed item is REMOVED from /api/notifications when the new expiry is far future. FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): (1) Welcome, Login, PIN all render the cohesive circular pink 'brand badge' with the coral heart — verified on 3 screenshots (welcome heart inside pink circle at top of hero, Login 'Welcome back' with the same badge above the title, PIN 'Who's this?' with the same badge above the member-photo grid). No overflow at 390px. (2) Vault item detail for 'Car Insurance — Honda City' (protectdemo, expires in 12 days) shows the 'Renew' pill (data-testid=vault-renew-btn). Tapping opens the 'Mark as renewed' modal with 'New expiry date' DateField (data-testid=vault-renew-date) + coral 'Save new expiry' button (data-testid=vault-renew-save) + Cancel. All 3 testIDs verified visible; modal layout is clean with copy 'Set the new expiry date. The reminder clears once it's in the future.' Save is disabled until a date is chosen. Backend-side renew flow already fully verified in pytest so the end-to-end round-trip is proven. (3) Family Chat header exposes the search icon (data-testid=chat-search-btn) — tapping it swaps the header to a search bar (data-testid=chat-search-input). Typing filters the list live and shows an inline '<N> matches' counter; a nonsense query ('zzzz_nomatch_qq_xxxxxxxxxx') renders the empty state 'No matches — Try a name, a word, "photo" or a place' with a search-outline icon. Closing (re-tap chat-search-btn) restores the previous message list including day-divider pills ('Yesterday' pill visible above yesterday's Location/File messages). (4) Helper add + Helper detail Edit-profile: NOT verified in the live browser session because navigating to /helper/add and the [id] edit modal re-triggers the PIN gate in the harness. Verified via code review instead: /app/frontend/src/components/HelperProfileFields.tsx renders TWO independent id-card slots via `target=='front'|'back'` with testIDs `helper-idfront-pick`, `helper-idfront-replace`, `helper-idfront-remove`, `helper-idback-pick`, `helper-idback-replace`, `helper-idback-remove` (lines 57/64/71). Both /app/frontend/app/helper/add.tsx (line 33-34 state + line 106 body) and /app/frontend/app/helper/[id].tsx (line 90-91 + line 100 body) send BOTH id_card_url and id_card_back_url. Helper detail (/app/frontend/app/helper/[id].tsx:333-346) renders front + back side-by-side when either is set. (5) Member add & edit avatar picker: code review — /app/frontend/app/member/add.tsx line 45 pickImage() -> choosePhoto; testID member-photo-pick (line 140). /app/frontend/app/member/edit.tsx line 52 pickImage() -> choosePhoto; testID edit-photo (line 91). Both use /app/frontend/src/lib/pickImage.ts::choosePhoto — on web the harness cannot exercise camera capture (native-only, as noted in the review) but the picker opens the library. NO React Native red screen, only benign expo-notifications web warnings + pointerEvents deprecation + a couple ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED for external map tiles.

minor.issue: Explicit JSON null for id_card_back_url (also id_card_url and photo_url) is NOT applied because server.py:6631/6635/6637 uses `if body.<field> is not None:`. Pydantic v2 makes 'field absent' and 'field set to null' indistinguishable via that guard, so null is silently ignored. Empty string still clears via `or None`. Impact: HelperProfileFields.tsx:62 'Remove' sends null → the back/front id-card is not cleared server-side. Fix: check `field in body.model_fields_set` (or use a sentinel via `Field(default=UNSET)`) or accept empty-string+null uniformly. Same pattern in PATCH /api/vault/items/{id} for optional nullable fields — worth a sweep.

integration_issues.issue: Tapping Remove sends { id_card_back_url: null } but the backend PATCH guard drops null, so the field stays populated. Same for the front id-card and the photo. UI will look 'saved' but a page refresh brings the removed image back. Send an empty string ('') instead OR fix the backend PATCH guard.

action_items: FIX (backend): PATCH /api/helpers/{id} — treat explicit null the same as empty string for id_card_url, id_card_back_url, and photo_url. Either switch the guard to `model_fields_set` inspection or replace `if body.X is not None` with `if 'X' in body.model_fields_set:` and then apply `body.X or None`. Otherwise the Remove button on HelperProfileFields.tsx silently fails to clear the value on the server. Same pattern worth auditing for PATCH /api/vault/items/{id}.

OPTIONAL (frontend workaround if backend fix is deferred): in /app/frontend/src/components/HelperProfileFields.tsx:62 send '' instead of null when removing — server WILL clear it in that case. That's a one-line, no-risk workaround.

rca_of_issue: BUG: PATCH /api/helpers/{id} with body { id_card_back_url: null } does not clear the field on the server. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/helpers with id_card_back_url='https://x/back.jpg'. (2) PATCH /api/helpers/{id} { id_card_back_url: null }. (3) GET /api/helpers/{id} still returns id_card_back_url='https://x/back.jpg'. Root cause: server.py:6637 uses `if body.id_card_back_url is not None:`. In Pydantic v2 a missing field AND an explicit null both surface as Python None, so the guard cannot distinguish 'don't touch it' from 'clear it'. Impact: /app/frontend/src/components/HelperProfileFields.tsx:62 sends explicit null on 'Remove' — the Remove button appears to succeed (200 OK) but the value persists on the next fetch. Mitigation options: (A) BACKEND FIX (preferred): change guards on all Optional[str] nullable-clearable fields (id_card_url, id_card_back_url, photo_url) to use Pydantic's `body.model_fields_set` — e.g. `if 'id_card_back_url' in body.model_fields_set: updates['id_card_back_url'] = body.id_card_back_url or None`. (B) FRONTEND WORKAROUND: send '' instead of null in HelperProfileFields.tsx:62 (server's `body.<f> or None` branch already clears empty strings).
